newsitem.title: USA: Dravo Corp in talks with prospective buyers.
newsitem.headline: Dravo Corp in talks with prospective buyers.

text.p: Dravo Corp said Thursday that although no formal offers to buy the company have been received, it is engaged in continuing discussions with prospective buyers.

The company said its most important initiative concerning the proposed sale is the investment banking review, which began last fall. If talks produce a formal offer, the board will give it serious consideration and report developments to shareholders, it said.
Dravo said the talks will not distract the company from its long term strategy to increase earnings through its line production operations and propriety environmental technologies.
